depth_selection: Maximize mean reciprocal rank of the first predeclared full match in F at depth 5 on development. In case of a tie use the smaller depth.

strategies.B: Legacy title lexical plus Dense fused with RRF
strategies.C: Metadata lexical plus Dense fused with RRF
strategies.E: The same permutation as D, then fused with the identical metadata lexical list from C
strategies.F: ColBERT on C, before the assistant window

unknown_policy: Unknown and unreviewed positions remain unknown. Report coverage and the observed nDCG, Hit, MRR and Recall based on known grades, separately from human judgment. No-known-positive queries are excluded from macro metrics with a positive denominator.
paired_ci: Fixed-seed resampling by query, 10000 percentile bootstrap samples.
pool: Union of top 20 from all six strategies plus predeclared good and control examples. Present without strategies, ranks, scores or prior labels.
notes: The 5.4-1C pool and labels form a separate regression slice. Existing 4.8 outputs are never merged into the main catalog metrics.
